polls.evidence_excerpt: Columns Republican / Democrat / Independent / Another: Dan S. Sullivan 75 / 3 / 43 / 34; Mary Peltola 9 / 93 / 41 / 26; demographics 38 / 28 / 30 / 4%. Article instead says Sullivan 41 and Peltola 43 among independents.
polls.notes: Do not ingest: R/I/D basis and leaners not established. Article reverses the table’s independent candidate percentages, and incorrectly attributes Peltola’s House service to Sullivan; seek clarification or corrected source. Group Ns are floor(775 × rounded composition), estimates only, not reported unweighted or exact weighted counts; source methodology says survey weighted. Another-party group is separate, not folded into Independent. Release date Oct 19 independently reported by Wikipedia and political.org, absent on retrieved original page. Source lists Daniel J. Sullivan Jr. as Republican; other sources report no party affiliation.
